column2: North Star (candidate). Decks generated -> exported -> kept and edited per active deck-maker per week. A redo = the value failed, so it encodes 'editable AND designed'.
THE concept-proving metric. Share of exported slide objects that are natively editable (real shapes/text, not flattened images) — the anti-Gamma metric.
Share of new signups who generate AND export a first editable deck <= 7d.
Share of activated users who return and export another deck the next week.
LLM inference + render cost per generated deck (COGS).
